concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: polished landscape gameplay concept for Last Chance Resort, a physics-based beach volleyball game.
Input image 1: visual reference only for the approved moonlit resort, camera, court layout, adult player design, and rendering style. Create a new gameplay moment with prominent delivery DRONES and robot HAZARDS.
Scene: midnight navy sky, moonlit silver-blue ocean, sparse palms framing the edges, warm window lights of a small hotel on the right cliff. Keep the background quieter than interactive objects.
Style: polished stylized 3D game render with believable materials and adult anatomy, crisp legible silhouettes, warm foreground lighting against a cool scenic backdrop. Humorous malfunctioning automated tropical hospitality, not combat.
Composition: single wide 16:10 gameplay image, fixed orthographic straight side view. A continuous horizontal court floor at 84% frame height over a dark foreground plinth; straight vertical wall at each outer 4%, glowing cyan service button left and coral button right. Center net shown edge-on as a slim upright pole from the floor to 57% frame height, no broad sideways net. Two adult players: dark-haired man in teal shorts on left half, ponytailed woman in coral sportswear on right half, natural articulated ragdoll motion. Volleyball clearly visible. Players upright height approximately 22% of frame. All robots, drones and players share one consistent polished 3D style and lighting.
Delivery drones: unmistakable quadcopters with FOUR propeller arms and spinning rotor discs, a compact friendly resort-service body, status light, a wrapped gift box carried below using a small claw or sling. Clearly show rotors and package separately. Drone bodies with propellers about half a player's standing height. Not bees, insects or winged mascots.
Hazards: visible physical resort-service machines that disrupt the volleyball match, sized around half to two-thirds player height, with readable mechanisms. Use the specific robots in the variant below. Keep drones and hazards distinct from each other. Every subject separated and readable at game scale.
Constraints: gameplay concept, not a poster or asset sheet. No words, HUD, watermark, arrows, labels, collage or extra panels. No weapons, violence, gore, crowd or extra human characters. Keep ample uncluttered sky and ball travel space, sparse small visual effects, no overwhelming glow or particle fog.
Variant: Gift delivery during a rally. Elegant rounded white and teal resort robotics.
Show TWO clearly visible quadcopter gift couriers hovering above the respective halves: left at x24% y43%, right at x77% y40%; rotor arms spread horizontally, each carries one brightly wrapped coral or turquoise gift with ribbon.
Man at x35% leaping to hit the ball at x43% y53%; woman at x69% braced to receive, both fully visible.
Show exactly TWO ground hazards, visually prominent and understandable: left at x16% a friendly luggage-assistant robot with a large red horseshoe magnet mounted on an articulated arm, magnet aimed toward the man's leg, only a few thin curved attraction traces; right at x85% a compact fitness-coach robot on a wheel base, with two oversized coral boxing-glove arms, one glove extending toward the woman. Machines have warm small status lights and rounded white shells. Show clear separation between robots and players. The mood is a beautiful resort interrupted by absurd automated service.
